title: scoreResourceHost
responsibility: Score one computer for one work request: fit, ranking score and human-readable reasons

inputs.name: scoreResourceHost.host
inputs.description: The computer to score, with its snapshot, workload and launcher state.

inputs.name: scoreResourceHost.work
inputs.description: The work request: kind, memory, project, provider and whether it is heavy or light.

inputs.name: scoreResourceHost.classification
inputs.description: The result of classifyResourceHost for this computer.

inputs.name: scoreResourceHost.policy
inputs.description: Keep-free RAM by role and the other placement rules.

outputs.name: scoreResourceHost
outputs.description: The candidate for one computer: whether it fits, its Tracker-style score (negative infinity when offline), status and human-readable reasons.

outputs.name: scoreResourceHost
